definitions.explanation: A person who deceives others to obtain money or valuables through dishonest means.

examples.japanese: {詐欺師|さぎし}に{騙|だま}された。
examples.english: I was deceived by a con artist.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{詐欺師|さぎし}として{逮捕|たいほ}された。
examples.english: He was arrested as a swindler.

examples.japanese: {詐欺師|さぎし}は{巧|たく}みな{話術|わじゅつ}で{人|ひと}を{騙|だま}す。
examples.english: Con artists deceive people with skillful rhetoric.

notes:
A person who deceives others for money or profit. Strongly negative — calling someone a {詐欺師|さぎし} is a serious accusation.

FORMS:
{詐欺|さぎ} (fraud, swindle) + {師|し} (master, expert — here ironic, implying skill at deception).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {詐欺師|さぎし}に{騙|だま}される: to be deceived by a con artist
- {詐欺師|さぎし}として{逮捕|たいほ}される: to be arrested as a swindler
- {天才|てんさい}{詐欺師|さぎし}: genius con artist

RELATED WORDS:
- {詐欺|さぎ}: fraud, swindle
- {詐欺|さぎ}{罪|ざい}: the crime of fraud
- {振|ふ}り{込|こ}め{詐欺|さぎ}: bank transfer scam (common in Japan)
- ペテン{師|し}: swindler, charlatan (older, literary nuance)
